messages.subject: Checkpoint GPU RNG/device and missing-state validation
messages.body: Additional checkpoint.py source contracts to cover: torch.load(map_location=device) moves saved CPU Torch RNG ByteTensor onto CUDA, but _restore_rng passes it straight to torch.set_rng_state which requires CPU; load payload on CPU or explicitly return RNG state to CPU before restore. Missing rng/trainer/scaler/cache fields are currently accepted through get(default) and state_dict counters default0, silently weakening resume; require complete schema appropriate to enabled factors and reject inconsistent manifest/config/counter/state. GPU behavior is static review only, NOT RUN. Existing same-platform CPU next-step witness remains valid.
